annotations.title: EVM developer utilities toolbox: checksum, keccak, selectors, units

description: One call that works out what an EVM value is and converts it every useful way: an address gets its EIP-55 checksum and bytes32 form; a signature its 4-byte selector and event topic; calldata is decoded (ERC-20, NFT, permit, EIP-3009); a bytes32 becomes uint256, address and units; a number converts between wei, gwei, ether (or any decimals) and hex; text gets keccak256. Local, no network. Use for building or debugging contracts and agents. Example: input=transfer(address,uint256). Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

input.description: An address, signature, calldata, hex value, number or text
